global.tone: Faithful, natural contemporary German; preserve profanity, dark humor, emotional intensity, names, and deliberate verbal distortions.
global.honorifics: Preserve honorifics retained by the English localization.
global.address_policy: Use du among students and close allies unless the scene explicitly establishes formal distance; use Sie for institutional or formal address. Keep every relationship consistent within a route.
global.terminology_policy: Use approved glossary entries consistently. Never translate character names or nicknames. In combat text, spaces are Felder, not Leerzeichen.
